Website: [hudsonvalleyretreat.com](https://hudsonvalleyretreat.com) | | **Catskills Yoga & Healing Center** | Saugerties, NY | Plant‑based menu, organic produce, daily vegetarian workshops | Spa with aromatherapy, hot stone massages, sauna, steam room | Phone: +1 845‑555‑5678

Website: [westchesterretreat.com](https://westchesterretreat.com) | All three centers combine yoga practice with a focus on healthy, plant‑based eating and a range of spa treatments to help you unwind and rejuvenate.
